title.en: Fragmenting a datagram: lengths, offsets and the MF flag
title.zh: 数据报分片：长度、偏移和 MF 标志

description.en: Why a router cuts a datagram into fragments, which header fields let the destination put it back together, and how to work out every fragment's length, offset and MF flag, including the multiple-of-8 trap.
description.zh: 路由器为什么把数据报切成分片，哪些首部字段让目的主机把它拼回去，以及怎样算出每个分片的长度、偏移和 MF 标志，包括 8 的倍数这个陷阱。

name.zh: 最大传输单元与分片重组 (MTU, fragmentation and reassembly)
路径 MTU 发现 (path MTU discovery)
IPv4 数据报格式 (IPv4 datagram structure)

description.en: Giving the fragment offset in bytes instead of 8-byte units
description.zh: 把分片偏移写成字节数，而不是以 8 字节为单位

description.en: Forgetting that every fragment carries its own 20-byte header
description.zh: 忘了每个分片都要带自己的 20 字节首部

title.en: A practice problem, in the style of the exam
title.zh: 练习题 · 仿考试题型

paras.en: An IP datagram of 4000 bytes (a 20-byte header with no options, and 3980 bytes of data) arrives at a router that must forward it over a link whose MTU is 1500 bytes.
paras.zh: 一个 4000 字节的 IP 数据报（20 字节首部，没有选项；3980 字节数据）到达一台路由器，路由器要把它转发到一条 MTU 为 1500 字节的链路上。

paras.en: How many fragments are sent? For each fragment, give its total length, its fragment offset and its MF flag.
paras.zh: 会发出几个分片？对每个分片，给出它的总长度、分片偏移和 MF 标志。

items.en: **MTU** (maximum transmission unit): the largest packet a link can carry, header included.
items.zh: **MTU**（最大传输单元）：一条链路能运载的最大分组，包括首部。

items.en: **Total length**: the IP header field that gives the size of each fragment, its header included.
items.zh: **总长度**：IP 首部里的字段，给出每个分片的大小，包括它的首部。

items.en: **Fragment offset** and **MF** (more fragments): the header fields that say where a fragment's data belongs in the original and whether more fragments follow. Both are built below.
items.zh: **分片偏移**和 **MF**（还有分片）：首部里说明分片的数据在原数据报中的位置、后面还有没有分片的字段。下面从头讲。

title.en: Cutting a datagram, and putting it back
title.zh: 把数据报切开，再拼回去

text.en: Every network has its own MTU, set by its hardware and its standards (1500 bytes for Ethernet). When a datagram is larger than the MTU of the next link, the router cuts it into **fragments**, each a datagram of its own with its own header. They travel separately and are put back together only at the **destination**.
text.zh: 每种网络都有自己的 MTU，由硬件和标准决定（以太网是 1500 字节）。数据报比下一条链路的 MTU 大时，路由器就把它切成若干**分片**，每个分片都是一个带自己首部的数据报。它们各自走，到了**目的主机**才拼回去。

text.en: Three header fields make that possible (the course's IPv4 header):
text.zh: 有三个首部字段让这件事成为可能（课上讲的 IPv4 首部）：

items.en: **Identification**: the same in every fragment of one datagram, so the destination knows which pieces belong together.
items.zh: **标识**（Identification）：同一个数据报的所有分片都相同，目的主机靠它知道哪些分片是一起的。

items.en: **MF**, more fragments: 1 in every fragment except the last.
items.zh: **MF**（还有分片）：除了最后一个，每个分片都是 1。

items.en: **Fragment offset**: where this fragment's data starts in the original data, counted in **units of 8 bytes**. The field has 13 bits while the total length has 16, so offsets can only name every 8th byte. Every fragment except the last must therefore carry a multiple of 8 data bytes.
items.zh: **分片偏移**：这个分片的数据在原数据里从哪儿开始，以 **8 字节为单位**。这个字段只有 13 位，而总长度有 16 位，所以偏移只能每隔 8 个字节标一个位置。因此除了最后一个分片，每个分片携带的数据都必须是 8 的倍数。

alt.en: The 4000-byte datagram: a 20-byte header and 3980 bytes of data. Below, three fragments, each with its own header: 1480 bytes of data at offset 0 with MF 1; 1480 at offset 185 with MF 1; 1020 at offset 370 with MF 0.
alt.zh: 4000 字节的数据报：20 字节首部加 3980 字节数据。下面是三个分片，各带自己的首部：1480 字节数据，偏移 0，MF 1；1480 字节，偏移 185，MF 1；1020 字节，偏移 370，MF 0。

caption.en: The data is cut, not the header: each fragment gets a fresh 20-byte header in front of its piece.
caption.zh: 切的是数据，不是首部：每个分片在自己那段数据前面都配一个新的 20 字节首部。

say.en: Each fragment needs its own 20-byte header, so at most 1480 bytes of data fit.
say.zh: 每个分片都要自己的 20 字节首部，所以最多装 1480 字节数据。

say.en: 1480 is a multiple of 8, so it can be used as it is.
say.zh: 1480 是 8 的倍数，可以直接用。

say.en: The 3980 bytes of data need three fragments.
say.zh: 3980 字节数据需要三个分片。

say.en: The offsets: where each piece starts in the data, divided by 8.
say.zh: 偏移：每段在数据里的起点，除以 8。

say.en: The total lengths: data plus a 20-byte header each. MF is 1, 1, 0: only the last says no more follow.
say.zh: 总长度：各自的数据加 20 字节首部。MF 依次是 1、1、0：只有最后一个表示后面没有了。

prompt.en: The third fragment's data starts at byte 2960 of the data. What is its fragment offset?
prompt.zh: 第三个分片的数据从数据的第 2960 字节开始。它的分片偏移是多少？

paras.en: Each fragment carries its own 20-byte header, so at most 1500 − 20 = 1480 bytes of data (a multiple of 8, as offsets count 8-byte units). The 3980 bytes of data need 3 fragments: 1480 + 1480 + 1020. All three keep the original datagram's identification.
paras.zh: 每个分片带自己的 20 字节首部，所以最多携带 1500 − 20 = 1480 字节数据（是 8 的倍数，因为偏移以 8 字节为单位）。3980 字节数据需要 3 个分片：1480 + 1480 + 1020。三个分片都保留原数据报的标识。

text.en: The two usual slips: giving the offset in bytes (1480, 2960) rather than in units of 8; and forgetting that every fragment needs its own header (which would give 1500-byte pieces of data).
text.zh: 两个常见的错：把偏移写成字节数（1480、2960），而不是 8 字节为单位；忘了每个分片都要自己的首部（那样会得出 1500 字节一段的数据）。

title.en: The multiple-of-8 trap, and not fragmenting at all
title.zh: 8 的倍数陷阱，以及干脆不分片

text.en: Here 1480 happened to be a multiple of 8. With an MTU of 1006, the room for data is 986 bytes, which is not: every fragment but the last can carry only **984**, the largest multiple of 8 that fits.
text.zh: 这道题里 1480 恰好是 8 的倍数。如果 MTU 是 1006，留给数据的是 986 字节，不是 8 的倍数：除最后一个以外，每个分片只能装 **984** 字节，也就是装得下的最大的 8 的倍数。

text.en: Fragmentation has costs: if any fragment is lost, the whole datagram is lost, and reassembly takes work and memory at the destination. The course's alternative is **path MTU discovery**: the sender sets the **DF** (don't fragment) bit. A router that would have to fragment drops the packet instead and sends back an ICMP message giving its MTU, and the sender makes its packets smaller. After a few tries, the packets fit the whole path.
text.zh: 分片是有代价的：任何一个分片丢了，整个数据报就丢了；重组还要占用目的主机的处理和内存。课上讲的另一条路是**路径 MTU 发现**：发送方设置 **DF**（不要分片）位。本来要分片的路由器改为丢弃这个分组，并回一个 ICMP 消息告知自己的 MTU，发送方就把分组改小。试几次之后，分组就能通过整条路径了。

prompt.en: A 2000-byte datagram (20-byte header) must cross a link with an MTU of 1006 bytes. How many bytes of data does each fragment but the last carry?
prompt.zh: 一个 2000 字节的数据报（20 字节首部）要经过一条 MTU 为 1006 字节的链路。除最后一个外，每个分片携带多少字节数据？

feedback.en: 986 is not a multiple of 8, and the next fragment's offset must be.
feedback.zh: 986 不是 8 的倍数，而下一个分片的偏移必须能用 8 字节为单位表示。

feedback.en: The fragment's 20-byte header must fit in the MTU too.
feedback.zh: 分片自己的 20 字节首部也得算进 MTU。

explain.en: $1006 - 20 = 986$, rounded down to a multiple of 8: 984. The 1980 bytes of data become 984 + 984 + 12, at offsets 0, 123 and 246.

prompt.en: In that case, what is the fragment offset of the last fragment?
prompt.zh: 在这种情况下，最后一个分片的分片偏移是多少？

explain.en: Its data starts at byte $984 \times 2 = 1968$, and $1968 / 8 = 246$.

prompt.en: A datagram with the DF bit set reaches a router whose next link's MTU is too small. What does the router do?
prompt.zh: 一个设置了 DF 位的数据报到达一台路由器，下一条链路的 MTU 太小。路由器怎么做？

label.en: Drops it and sends the sender an ICMP message with the MTU
label.zh: 丢弃它，并给发送方回一个带 MTU 的 ICMP 消息

feedback.en: DF means *don't fragment*: the router must not.
feedback.zh: DF 的意思就是“不要分片”：路由器不能分。

label.en: Sends it in one piece and lets the link truncate it
label.zh: 整个发出去，让链路截断

feedback.en: A link cannot carry a packet larger than its MTU at all.
feedback.zh: 链路根本无法运载超过 MTU 的分组。

explain.en: That message is what path MTU discovery relies on: the sender learns the limit and sends smaller packets.
explain.zh: 路径 MTU 发现靠的就是这条消息：发送方得知上限，就改发更小的分组。
